name: Truly Aariya LinkedIn calendar
direction: The Gold Leaf Edition: cream off-white textured paper on every design (pastel colours only in small details), Cormorant Garamond display type and Jost caps, and ONE gold-foil hero element per design that acts out the whole message (a kintsugi seam, a pen nib, a gold leaf strip, an hourglass, gold roots, a gold thread). Premium stationery feel: fine gold hairline frame, running header, lots of space. Never dark or loud backgrounds. Every visual carries @trulyaariya and 'A Self Repaired Soul · Book coming soon'.

series.Notes from a Debut Author: Building in public: what two years of writing a first book looked like, and what she is learning about launching it. LinkedIn rewards honest work stories.
series.The 9-to-5 Edition: The same healing theme as Instagram, moved into working life: meetings, inboxes, team photos, burnout, the LinkedIn feed itself.
series.Then / Now: Before/after designs: the grey 'then' and the gold 'now'. Before/after is one of the most saved formats on LinkedIn this month.
series.I'll Go First: She answers first, then invites one-line answers. Posts built this way are pulling the most comments in the personal-growth niche right now.
series.Margin Notes: Reflective lines with one gold element doing the talking: a gold leaf, gold roots, a gold swing, gold birds.

days.instagram_theme: No Instagram post today: the LinkedIn book announcement
days.angle: Her first LinkedIn post: announce the debut book, A Self Repaired Soul: Journey That Heals, publishing soon.
lines: Two years of writing. One book.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper split by one lit gold kintsugi seam running top to bottom: something broken, mended with gold. The title is set large in gold foil beside it.
days.hook:
Two years ago I started writing something I didn't tell many people about.
Today I can finally share it: my first book, A Self Repaired Soul: Journey That Heals, is publishing soon.
days.cta: Follow along if you'd like to be here when it's out.

days.instagram_theme: If my book were a song, a season, a place, a person
days.angle: A magazine-style questionnaire page. She answers four questions about the book; the last answer is in her gold handwriting.
lines: If it were a song: your 1 a.m. playlist
A season: the first cool morning after summer
A place: the warm corner of your bed
A person: the friend who stays on the call till you fall asleep
days.visual: Cream off-white paper, magazine questionnaire with gold hairline rules. Hero: the last answer set in gold foil, with a gold coiled phone line beside it (the friend who stays on the call).
days.hook:
If my book were a person, it would be the friend who stays on the call until you fall asleep.
I answered four questions about it. Your turn for one.
days.cta: If your work were a season, which one would it be?

days.instagram_theme: The song you play when no one's home is healing too
days.angle: The song people play in the car or on the commute before walking into work.
lines: in the parking lot before work…
days.visual: Cream off-white paper. Gold hero: A gold-foil music staff flows across the page like a ribbon; gold notes land on it one by one. The song is the gold.
days.hook:
Everyone has a song they play in the parking lot before walking in.
I think it's doing more for us than we give it credit for.
days.cta: What's yours? One song, no explanation needed.

days.instagram_theme: Writing a book was never on my list
days.angle: Monday, career brain: the best thing she did was not in any plan.
lines: The one thing that mattered most
days.visual: Cream off-white paper. Gold hero: A soft planner card of grey ticked-off goals; at the bottom a big gold-foil tick and 'Write a book.' in gold: the one thing that mattered.
days.hook:
Writing a book was not in my five-year plan.
Not even at the bottom.
days.cta: What's the best thing you've done that was never on your list?

days.instagram_theme: Pressed flower regains its colour; not the person who opened the first page
days.angle: How two years of writing changed the writer.
lines: I'm not the person who opened the first blank page.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper. Gold hero: Stacked cream manuscript pages slide in (Day 1, Day 300, Day 730); a gold-leaf pressed leaf lies on top: two years, pressed in gold.
days.hook:
I'm not the person who opened that first blank page two years ago.
The book changed. So did I.
days.cta: What have you worked on long enough that it changed you?

days.instagram_theme: Seasons pass in a window, 2 a.m. rain, pages stack
days.angle: The unseen hours behind a first book.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper. Gold hero: A gold fountain-pen nib whose ink line becomes the gold underline beneath 'after midnight.'
days.hook:
Some of the most important work of my life happened when nobody was watching.
Mostly after midnight.
days.cta: When do you do your best thinking?

days.instagram_theme: Read this if sorry is the first word you say
days.angle: Over-apologising at work.
lines: Your feelings were never an inconvenience.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper. Gold hero: Rows of faint grey 'sorry' messages; gold lines strike through each row, then 'inconvenience.' lands in gold.
days.hook:
"Sorry, quick question." "Sorry for the late reply." "Sorry to bother you."
How many of those did you send this week?
days.cta: Try one message today without the sorry. Tell me how it felt.

days.instagram_theme: When you reach the last page, go a little easier on yourself
days.angle: What she wants a reader to feel, written as a short typed letter.
lines: When you reach the last page,
I hope you go a little easier on yourself.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper. Gold hero: A letter on cream paper with gilded gold edges; 'easier' set large in gold foil and her signature in gold.
days.hook:
Writers are told to know what they want a reader to feel.
Mine fits in six words: go a little easier on yourself.
days.cta: If a book could do one thing for you this year, what would it be?

days.instagram_theme: Grey knot unravels into gold; you're allowed to choose you
days.angle: Saying no without a long explanation.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper. Gold hero: A grey tangle of thread unwinds into one straight gold thread: choosing you.
days.hook:
A "no" doesn't need a three-paragraph explanation.
I'm still learning this one.
days.cta: What's the hardest thing for you to say no to?

days.instagram_theme: What this book won't tell you
days.angle: Contrarian list: the clichés the book refuses to say.
lines: 5 things my book won't tell you
It sits with you through it.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper. Gold hero: 'Just be positive.' in faded plum with one heavy gold-foil brushstroke struck through it.
days.hook:
My book won't tell you to "just be positive."
Here are four more things it won't say.
days.cta: Which one have you heard the most?

days.instagram_theme: Then: one text left on seen. Same text, softer you
days.angle: Overthinking a message, then and now.
lines: one message on 'seen' ran my whole night.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper. Gold hero: Then: a grey scribble cloud of overthinking. Now: a single calm gold horizon line.
days.hook:
Then: one message left on "seen" could take over my whole night.
Now: same message. Different me.
days.cta: What's one thing that used to shake you and doesn't anymore?

days.instagram_theme: Coming soon: the cover behind the glass
days.angle: Cover tease. Fully blurred, never revealed.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper. Gold hero: A frosted glass panel in a lit gold frame; only a soft blur behind it. 'Revealing soon' in gold.
days.hook:
The cover is finished.
I'm just not ready to show you yet.
days.cta: Follow so you see it the day it's out.

days.instagram_theme: Rest before you're empty
days.angle: Burnout and back-to-back calendars, the biggest wellbeing topic on LinkedIn right now.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper. Gold hero: A gold metal hourglass; the sand pours, then it tips onto its side and the sand stops. Rest in gold.
days.hook:
We schedule meetings, deadlines and launches.
Almost nobody puts rest on the calendar before they need it.
days.cta: Have you blocked any time for yourself this week?

days.instagram_theme: An envelope opens: the first words
days.angle: Curiosity about the opening of the book without revealing a word of it.
lines: Some words take two years to get right.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper. Gold hero: A cream envelope tied with a gold-foil ribbon and bow: words sealed till launch.
days.hook:
Some words take two years to get right.
The first ones in my book stay sealed until launch.
days.cta: Do you read the first page of a book before you buy it?

days.instagram_theme: Read this if everyone around you seems ahead
days.angle: The LinkedIn feed itself: promotions everywhere, and the person who closes the app feeling behind.
lines: Read this if everyone on your feed
days.visual: Cream off-white paper. Gold hero: Grey feed cards scroll past on the right; on the left one winding gold path drawn slowly: your own pace.
days.hook:
This app is full of announcements.
This one is for anyone who closes it feeling behind.
days.cta: Save it for the next scroll that makes you feel slow.

days.instagram_theme: A line from the book: the roots behind it
days.angle: Leaders and colleagues notice the change in someone, rarely the reason.
lines: We wonder why someone isn't quite themselves anymore…
without ever seeing the roots behind it.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper. Gold hero: A small green sprout above pastel soil; below it a full system of glowing gold roots: what we don't see.
days.hook:
We notice when someone at work changes.
We rarely ask what's underneath.
days.cta: Who checked on you when you weren't yourself?

days.instagram_theme: I miss the version of me who…
days.angle: Her line about herself, 'a kid at heart', and the version of us work tends to bury.
lines: I miss the version of me who…
She's waiting for me to let her play again.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper. Gold hero: An instant photo develops from grey into pastel colour; the swing inside is gold and starts to move.
days.hook:
I call myself a kid at heart.
Some weeks I forget to act like one.
days.cta: What did ten-year-old you want to be?

days.instagram_theme: One word: ink rain slows and stops
days.angle: A one-word comment prompt. Easy to answer, so it gets answers.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper. Gold hero: A hand-laid strip of torn gold leaf where the answer goes.
days.hook:
One word. No explanation.
What does healing feel like for you?
days.cta: I'll read every word in the comments.

days.instagram_theme: Then: couldn't talk about it without crying. That's how I knew it had healed
days.angle: What healing actually looks like from the outside.
lines: I couldn't talk about it without crying.
I can tell the story. That's how I knew.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper. Gold hero: A crumpled sheet smooths open; its creases are mended with gold kintsugi seams.
days.hook:
Healing didn't look like forgetting.
It looked like being able to tell the story without falling apart.
days.cta: Have you got a story like this?

days.instagram_theme: Smiled in a photo on your worst day
days.angle: The team photo, the offsite picture, the profile picture.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper. Gold hero: Three smiling pastel photos; the middle one in a gilded gold frame: 'the real week'.
days.hook:
Every team photo has at least one person smiling through their worst week.
Sometimes it's the one holding the camera.
days.cta: Check on someone today. Even a one-line message counts.

days.instagram_theme: Sometimes a little space is what softens it
days.angle: Hard conversations at work and at home: not all of them have to happen today.
lines: Everyone says: fix it right now.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper. Gold hero: Two paper boats on choppy water; the tangled rope becomes a loose gold thread as the water calms.
days.hook:
Not every hard conversation has to happen today.
Some go better tomorrow.
days.cta: Do you talk it out straight away or take a day?

days.instagram_theme: Send this to the friend who…
days.angle: The colleague or friend who makes things survivable.
lines: Send this to the colleague who…
This book is for both of you.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper. Gold hero: Two paper cups; their steam rises in gold and meets as a heart.
days.hook:
Every workplace has one person who makes it survivable.
Tag yours.
days.cta: Tag them. They should know.

days.instagram_theme: Forgiven everyone except yourself
days.angle: Self-forgiveness after a mistake.
lines: Read this if you've forgiven everyone
days.visual: Cream off-white paper. Gold hero: Crossed-out notebook lines; the last line is gold and lifts off the page as gold birds.
days.hook:
Most of us forgive other people's mistakes faster than our own.
I'm working on that.
days.cta: Save this for the nights you're hard on yourself.

days.instagram_theme: Every name is made up. Every feeling is real
days.angle: Why readers will recognise themselves without any real names.
lines: Every name in my book is made up.
Every feeling in it is real.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper. Gold hero: Three blank name tags; the middle one is mended with a gold kintsugi seam.
days.hook:
Every name in my book is made up.
Every feeling in it is real.
days.cta: Have you ever read a book that felt like it knew you?

days.instagram_theme: Healing is a hundred small ordinary days
days.angle: Compounding, the habit-tracker way LinkedIn loves.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper. Gold hero: A 10x10 grid of pastel tiles fills day by day; the 100th tile is gold and a gold seam runs through the grid.
days.hook:
We celebrate launch day.
Nobody posts the hundred ordinary days before it.
days.cta: What small thing did you do for yourself today?

days.instagram_theme: Remember the name
days.angle: Name recall: the title set in letterpress.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper. Gold hero: Gold metal letterpress blocks set the title in reverse; a printed card beside them with 'Soul' in gold.
days.hook:
Four words I've lived with for two years.
Save this so you remember them.
days.cta: Follow along for the launch.

days.instagram_theme: Calendar pages flip through two years
days.angle: Twenty-four months in twenty seconds.
lines: Most of them looked like nothing
All of them are in this book.
days.visual: Cream off-white paper. Gold hero: Month pages flip from 1 to 24; the final page's band turns gold foil: Month 24.
days.hook:
Twenty-four months.
Most of them looked like nothing from the outside.
days.cta: What are you building that nobody can see yet?
